notes.title: News: Next version, and... can we get the team growing?
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

[b]About the next version[/b]

The next version is coming in a couple of weeks, here is a few hints about what's coming:

- New filler events, acting as small interactions and/or visuals here and there to increase the overall liveliness.
[i]It looks like Zoe may now be doing things while you are at work?[/i]
[i]To give you an idea, I count Zoe asking you to be naked before being allowed to speak to her as a "filler event"[/i]

- Better VR, again, but this time I think we are reaching an actually playable threshold. The most notable change will be a camera with 0 movement during looping animations, which was I think the last major problem remaining.
No more motion sickness at all? Let's hope so!

- Many bug fixes, as always

- A reworked event selector, making unseen repeatable events more accessible (finally)!

- Several new average events (re-using older animations, or not using a whole new set of animations).

You get the idea, the next version wants to fill the game with a larger amount of smaller novelties, instead of adding a single, completely new event!

[b]About the team[/b]

As you probably know, I'm currently working alone on the project. But that may yet change!

I know a professional animator that may be interested to join the project. As for now, this is not possible, but if I can get enough financial stability through Steam and Patreon, that could become a reality.

There is no need to say that she would greatly help with both increasing the amount of content and increasing the quality, while adding a welcome feminine touch to the game's overall approach.

So here's the big idea, if in the next two months the Patreon can reach €1600/month to give us some security, we'll do a trial run together and work on a "go fund me" DLC, the sole purpose of which will be to pay her salary for the coming year.

The content of the DLC is as of yet unknown, we'll probably work on a set of unique clothes, but to be honest, the DLC itself is really is a mean to an end.

The real purpose of all of this is to double the amount of produced content!

So, let's see if we can make it happen :) Let me know in the comments if you'd welcome something like this!

Have a nice day everyone!

notes.title: Beta version - VR for Windows!
notes.notes:
[b]Zoe - VR version is now available for beta-testing![/b]

Hello everyone!

I'm pleased to present a VR version of the game on Steam! (Windows only).

This is a beta version, [u]I need feedback to improve the concept[/u]. I could only test it on Oculus 2, hopefuly the inputs will work correctly on other headsets.

You can test it by changing the Steam branch to "vr_version" and selecting the 2nd launch option.

Join the Discord or open a thread in the Steam community to share your comments!

Have a great day,
Stay safe!
